faq.q1: What is the best age to start learning?
faq.a1: We recommend starting as early as 3-4 years old. At this stage, we focus on cognitive play to build spatial awareness and basic logic through fun chess-themed games.
faq.q2: Do you provide FIDE certified coaching?
faq.a2: Yes, our lead coaches are FIDE-certified and have over 15 years of international coaching experience. We follow official Hong Kong and global standards.
faq.q3: Do you offer online or hybrid classes?
faq.a3: Absolutely. We use advanced chess software and interactive platforms so students across Hong Kong can learn from home without losing tactical quality.
faq.q4: How do you track student progress?
faq.a4: Every student receives a digital progress report every term detailing rating growth, tactical accuracy, and strategic focus areas.
